messages:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: exception routing for contractor->FTE conversion. Candidate: Priyanka Rao (was contractor), role: Senior Security Engineer. Manager requests compband S5 (guideline S4), $18k sign-on net (requests gross-up), accelerated 25% equity vest at 6 months, and benefits retro to contractor start 2026-03-01. Need approvals and legal tax check.
Leo (Hiring Mgr): Pri is already integrated; converting helps retention. S5 needed for parity with internal hires. Accelerated equity is to recognize prior contractor time. Retro benefits critical for candidate to accept.
Ana (Recruiter): Candidate willing to convert; asking for written confirmation of retro benefits and net sign-on numbers before signing. Notice period is 2 weeks.
Sam (Compben): Policy: retroactive benefits are rare. For contractor time to count toward vesting we need documented contractor agreement and equity policy sign-off. Gross-up for sign-on is unusual for sign-ons < $25k but possible for conversions. Please post full proposed comp and vesting schedule.
Maya (People Ops): Proposed package pasted: 
```
base: $185,000
bonus target: $18,500
sign-on: 18,000 USD (request net; propose gross-up to reach net)
equity: 80,000 grant value, 4yr with 1yr cliff; request 25% accelerated vest at 6mo to credit contractor service
benefits retro: request medical + 401k eligibility from 2026-03-01 (contractor start)
total disclosed year1 cash (incl sign-on grossed): ~221,500
```
Ben (Finance): Need gross-up calc and impact on payroll. If gross-up is requested we must document tax treatment and GL mapping. Retro benefits may create prior-period liabilities; payroll will need to confirm whether enrollment backdates are allowed.
Pri (Legal): Contractor->employee conversion raises prior contractor payment classification and equity eligibility questions. Need to review contractor agreement (was there an IP/equity clause?). Retro benefits enrollment can be done in limited cases but requires sign-off from benefits admin and potentially creates reporting obligations. Legal needs to review tax exposure for gross-up and accelerated vest.
onboard-bot: HR conversion form created in Workday WD-7782, status: pending approvals (people-ops -> compben -> finance -> legal -> vp-people).
Leo (Hiring Mgr): We are flexible on exact gross-up method if that speeds things. Manager agrees to document prior contractor contribution in onboarding notes. Approve accelerated vest to 25% at 6mo if legal signs off.
Sam (Compben): I can support accelerated vest only if contractor had no prior equity and if we treat the accelerated portion as a one-time grant. Will draft language and require documentation that the contractor was not previously denied equity. Also will only approve retro benefits if benefits admin confirms no retro premiums owed, otherwise candidate must cover prior premiums.
Ben (Finance): I'll run a quick gross-up example assuming 22% effective tax; gross-up ~$5,000 (so gross ~23k) — will post exact calc in GH. For retro benefits, payroll flags prior-period contributions — need benefits admin input.
Pri (Legal): I'll review contractor agreement and provide memo on equity eligibility and any clawback language needed for accelerated vest. Also need to confirm we can promise no tax surprises post gross-up.
Maya (People Ops): Tagging @Nina (VP People) for S5 approval and gross-up exception sign-off. Also loop in benefits admin for retro enrollment feasibility.
onboard-bot: Offer draft GH-99200 created with placeholder language for gross-up and accelerated vest; routing updated.
Nina (VP People): Quick read: conversion seems reasonable given retention risk. Approve S5 exception contingent on Legal memo and Finance gross-up calc. Approve accelerated 25% vest at 6mo as one-time credit. Retro benefits approved only if benefits admin confirms no material retro premiums or if candidate agrees to cover back premiums. Approving conditional routing now.
Ana (Recruiter): I'll tell candidate we have conditional approvals and expect final numbers by end of week. Candidate asked about 401k matching for retro months — will note benefits admin may require catch-up contributions.
Maya (People Ops): Actions: Legal to post memo, Finance to post gross-up calc and GL codes, Compben to update offer language, Benefits admin to confirm retro-enrollment feasibility. Recruiter to hold verbal acceptance until final language. Will close thread after Workday WD-7782 approved and offer signed. Thanks all :raised_hands:
